sprints.goal: Convert and rewrite AI Influence for full FWG interaction, with improved political/world actions, temporal knowledge graph, verbose history, grounded decisions and save integrity.

Evaluate the design across multiple inference models and heavier LittleBit-compressed parents: tool correctness, political/temporal decision drift, long-history retrieval, runtime cost and live gameplay.

tickets.title: FWG conversion/rewrite and long-campaign knowledge graph — acceptance
Multi-model, heavy LittleBit and longitudinal design evaluations — acceptance
Freeze AI Influence code evidence and Bannerlord political hook map
Define FWG conversion/rewrite, feature coverage and decision authority
Establish LittleBit and target-hardware feasibility
Expose versioned FWG facts and live campaign context
Implement typed tool proposals and validated game-thread execution
Build asynchronous local inference transport and request lifecycle
Implement temporal campaign knowledge graph and durable event history
Connect grounded dialogue and tool results to player UI
Implement political intrigue with beliefs, commitments and consequences
Implement Bannerlord political and economic action adapters
Resolve AI versus vanilla political simulation ownership
Implement generated-world travel, practical orders and grounded quests
Bridge AI fantasy actions into real FWG mutation
Schedule NPC initiative and world events within simulation budgets
Make memory, plans and world actions save-consistent
Verify full FWG interaction vertical slices
Freeze design-level multi-model and long-campaign evaluation contracts
Compare multiple inference models and heavier tool-capable parents
Produce and evaluate genuine LittleBit model derivatives
Integrate the selected LittleBit runtime with live Bannerlord
Publish paired evaluation results and final model decision
Implement graph-grounded retrieval and bounded long-history context
Ground AI decisions in evidence and detect long-campaign drift
Run longitudinal drift and knowledge-graph ablations across models
Port recovered governance actions: clan expulsion, kingdom taxes and quarantine
